Describe tables as plain text

Source: R/describe.R
sv_describe.Rd

Reads each table and writes one sentence for the table and one line for each column: its label, kind, missing and distinct counts, number ranges and the commonest text values. It is the text twin of looking at the cards on the canvas, for a screen reader or a console. A lazy (duckdb or Arrow) table is never collected: only the summaries of sv_column_profile() are read.

Usage

sv_describe(x, ..., n_levels = 5)

Arguments

x, ...

Data frames, duckdb tables or Arrow tables, named or not (an unnamed table is named from its expression, as in sideview()), or one list of them.

n_levels

How many of the commonest values of a text column to list.

Value

The lines, invisibly, as a character vector of class sv_description. Printing it writes one line per row.

Examples

patients <- data.frame(id = 1:4, sex = c("M", "F", "F", NA),
                       age = c(40, 51, 62, 38))
sv_describe(patients)
